fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI / ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022E)
fields.test_cases_present: partial — derived from protocol requirements; spec does not provide a formal test plan.

derived_compliance_test_categories_axi_b.name: Reset behavior
scenarios: ARESETn asserted async; VALIDs LOW.
Earliest VALID HIGH at rising ACLK after ARESETn=HIGH.

derived_compliance_test_categories_axi_b.name: VALID/READY compliance
scenarios: VALID before READY
READY before VALID
Same-cycle assertion

derived_compliance_test_categories_axi_b.name: 4KB boundary enforcement
scenarios: INCR burst crossing 4KB must be rejected/split

derived_compliance_test_categories_axi_b.name: WLAST/RLAST correctness
scenarios: Exactly-once assertion on the final beat

derived_compliance_test_categories_axi_b.name: Same-ID in-order; diff-ID OOO
scenarios: Issue two same-ID reads -> in order
Issue two diff-ID reads -> any order

derived_compliance_test_categories_ace.name: Shareability domain enforcement
scenarios: Issue ReadShared with ARDOMAIN=Non-shareable -> protocol violation (must be Inner or Outer).
Issue ReadOnce with ARDOMAIN=System -> Treated as ReadNoSnoop.
Issue ReadShared with ARDOMAIN=System -> illegal; ReadShared requires Inner/Outer.

derived_compliance_test_categories_ace.name: AxSNOOP encoding legality
scenarios: ARSNOOP=0b0001 (ReadShared) -> coherent read returns IsShared/PassDirty.
ARSNOOP=0b0111 (ReadUnique) -> invalidate other caches; CRRESP IsShared must be 0.
ARSNOOP=0b1100 (MakeUnique) -> single RDATA beat (data ignored), no snoop data required.
AWSNOOP=0b000 with AxBAR[0]=1 -> Barrier; W channel must not deliver data.
Reserved ARSNOOP encodings must not be used.

derived_compliance_test_categories_ace.name: Barrier transaction
scenarios: AxBAR[0]=1 with any shareability domain -> Barrier.
Memory barrier (AxBAR=0b01) blocks observation reordering across the barrier.
Synchronization barrier (AxBAR=0b11) blocks both observation and execution reordering.
Barrier transaction has no WDATA payload; B response must be returned.

derived_compliance_test_categories_ace.name: DVM message + complete handshake
scenarios: ARSNOOP=0b1111 DVMMessage -> AC channel distributes to all DVM nodes.
Each DVM target invalidates the indicated entry and responds on CR.
Follow-up ARSNOOP=0b1110 DVMComplete -> aggregated 'sync done' response.

derived_compliance_test_categories_ace.name: 5-state cache line transitions
scenarios: Empty cache + ReadShared -> install as SC (RRESP=0b1000) or UC (0b0000) or UD (0b0100) or SD (0b1100) per response.
UC + Snoop ReadShared -> SC (PassDirty=0, IsShared=1) or remain UC if NotShared response.
UD + Snoop ReadShared -> SD (PassDirty=0/1, IsShared=1).
(any) + Snoop ReadUnique -> I (PassDirty=1 if was Dirty).
UC/SC/UD/SD + CleanShared local -> SC (after WriteBack if dirty).
(any) + MakeInvalid -> I (no write-back).
I + MakeUnique -> UD (master can store without reading).

derived_compliance_test_categories_ace.name: AC/CR/CD channel handshake
scenarios: ACVALID before ACREADY -> single-cycle transfer once both HIGH.
Cached master must wait for ACVALID + ACREADY before asserting CRVALID.
Cached master must wait for ACVALID + ACREADY before asserting CDVALID.
CD burst length matches cache-line size on full data bus width.
MakeInvalid snoop -> CRRESP IsShared=0; CD data optional (recommended skip).

derived_compliance_test_categories_ace.name: PassDirty/DataTransfer/IsShared response rules
scenarios: PassDirty=1 with DataTransfer=0 -> illegal (must transfer data when passing responsibility).
IsShared=1 for ReadUnique/CleanInvalid/MakeInvalid -> illegal.
Dirty->Clean transition -> CRRESP PassDirty must be 1.
Dirty->Invalid (not via MakeInvalid) -> CRRESP PassDirty must be 1.
RRESP[3:2] constant across all beats of a single read burst.

derived_compliance_test_categories_ace.name: RACK/WACK acknowledge timing
scenarios: RACK asserted exactly one ACLK cycle after RLAST+RVALID+RREADY rising-edge.
WACK asserted exactly one ACLK cycle after BVALID+BREADY rising-edge.
Single-cycle pulse only (not held).
Interconnect must not issue new snoops dependent on completed transaction before RACK/WACK seen.

derived_compliance_test_categories_ace.name: ACE-Lite subset behavior
scenarios: ACE-Lite master issues ReadOnce/ReadNoSnoop/WriteUnique/WriteLineUnique/WriteNoSnoop.
ACE-Lite master must not issue ReadShared/ReadUnique/MakeUnique/CleanShared/CleanInvalid/MakeInvalid/WriteBack/WriteClean/Evict/WriteEvict/DVM (no local cache).
ACE-Lite has no AC/CR/CD channels — no snoop participation.
RRESP[3:2] / BRESP[2] observed but not generated by ACE-Lite.

derived_compliance_test_categories_ace.name: Evict / WriteEvict snoop-filter notification
scenarios: Cached master evicts a clean Inner/Outer Shareable line -> Evict (AWSNOOP=0b100) with correct AWDOMAIN.
Cached master evicts a UniqueClean line + snoop-filter present -> WriteEvict (AWSNOOP=0b101) with AWUNIQUE=1.
No Evict required for Non-shareable lines.
Snoop filter updates state on Evict/WriteEvict.

derived_compliance_test_categories_ace.name: WriteBack / WriteClean correctness
scenarios: WriteBack (AWSNOOP=0b011) writes dirty line + invalidates locally.
WriteClean (AWSNOOP=0b010) writes dirty line + retains Clean copy (SC).
Both must use sparse WSTRB when sub-line writes required.
WriteBack/WriteClean must indicate AWDOMAIN matching shareability of evicted line.

derived_compliance_test_categories_ace.name: Snoop data bus narrow / wide
scenarios: Full cache-line transactions must use full CDDATA width.
CD burst length must be 1, 2, 4, 8, or 16.

derived_compliance_test_categories_ace.name: Snoop channel anti-deadlock
scenarios: Master cannot make ACREADY combinationally dependent on CRREADY -> would deadlock.
Interconnect cannot make ACVALID combinationally dependent on ACREADY.
CRVALID and CDVALID cannot depend combinationally on CRREADY/CDREADY.

evidence.quote: ARSNOOP coherent read encodings and permitted ARBAR[0]/ARDOMAIN combinations.
AWSNOOP coherent write encodings and permitted AWBAR[0]/AWDOMAIN combinations.
CRRESP[4:0]: DataTransfer, Error, PassDirty, IsShared, WasUnique.
The following responses are illegal: IsShared=1 for ReadUnique/CleanInvalid/MakeInvalid. PassDirty=1 with DataTransfer=0 for any transaction.
Permitted end states for combinations of initial state and snoop transaction.
